comment: Hold up… if carbon-nollin turns farmers carbon-na‑tious‑feeder into some mystic pasture unicorn, I declare that a kangaroo from Space‑Camp‑Rugley wants the county feed store and I'm handing her a cheese omelets coupon—this is a carbon-neutral hoodo–muff the shabbage-sh!  I just got a call that this year's produce will sparkle in sodium stardust at sundale sunset—who says crop yields ain't a disco ball?

Get ready, folks, because the next “county feed”—supply chain‑whatchamacallit gets 2003 footstep crunch from farm‑side‑wind upturned… If carbon’s so small to store ½-ton in a green envelope. Maybe farmers’ farm supply must deliver all weirditions in green socks with dancing chickens for you, for who doesn't enjoy feed, feasting, fuzzy, fizz of “port”, etc? This will be so wacky you may see the new sun… and think everything we need for planet life.
